slots.notes: Fullscreen object-fit:cover hero background video behind nav + copy; absolute inset:0, z-index:-2, no scrim. Horizontally flipped (scaleX(-1)); desktop adds scale(1.12) + 26s Ken Burns zoom and loops natively, mobile force-loops back to 0 at 2s via timeupdate. Placeholder source is a CloudFront mp4 to be replaced by a brand asset.

Product/dashboard UI shown in the hero as a floating preview (aspect-ratio 1456/1138 ~= 1.28:1). Desktop: absolutely placed card with 16px radius + deep drop shadow. Mobile: 3D-perspective tilted card with 6.5s float animation. Spec embeds it as an iframe to dashboard-orchestrator.html; the brand fills this socket with its own product screenshot/mockup.

Brand logomark used in nav (24-28px), footer brand column and mobile brand lockup. Native art is a monochrome white circle+arc+dot inline SVG (26x26 viewBox, 1.6px strokes); recolored via stroke/fill = foreground white. Brand replaces with its own single-color mark.

Inline monochrome UI/glyph icons: nav chevron dropdown, play_circle (Watch demo ghost CTA), mail/envelope (waitlist + footer), submit arrow, and three social marks (X/Twitter, LinkedIn, GitHub). Sized 17-22px, tinted via currentColor (muted white -> #fff on hover). Brand swaps the social/glyph set; some are SVG, some come from the Material Icons Round font on desktop.

Display/serif typeface socket for h1 hero headline and footer CTA headings (also large mobile heading). Native = EB Garamond (400/500/600 + italics); <em> spans are italic and on mobile tinted with the accent (lime). Loaded from Google Fonts.
Body/UI sans typeface socket for nav, subtitles, buttons, footer links, form fields. Native = Hanken Grotesk (400/500/600/700). Loaded from Google Fonts.

mechanic: Fullscreen flipped + Ken-Burns/force-looped hero video under serif headline and pill CTAs, with a floating dashboard preview card (3D-tilted + float-animated on mobile) and a frosted-glass overlapping footer, all entering via staggered opacity/translate reveal transitions.
techDelivery: Two standalone HTML files (desktop + mobile) with all CSS inline in <style> and vanilla-JS reveal/accordion/video-loop logic, loaded via Google Fonts (incl. Material Icons Round on desktop); a thin React App.jsx switches between them in an iframe at a 768px matchMedia breakpoint.
reskinNotes: Logo art, social glyphs and chevron/mail/arrow icons are hardcoded inline SVG (stroke/fill #fff baked in) and must be re-pathed per brand; copy (brand name, headlines, nav labels, footer link lists, legal, copyright) is hardcoded in markup across both desktop and mobile files; CSS custom-property values differ between desktop and mobile (muted/line opacities, body bg #000 vs #060707) and the dashboard card position is pinned to magic-number custom properties (--dash-w/--dash-x/--dash-y) plus a fixed 1456/1138 aspect; serif h1 uses text-wrap:balance and ch-based max-widths so layout is font-metric dependent; lime accent <em> styling is tied to the EB Garamond italic.
